jobs.description:
For a company based in Veurne, specialised in metalworking, we are looking for a Maintenance Technician to work in various shift systems.

You will be working in an ultra-modern production environment that meets the highest standards in terms of quality, productivity and innovation. A very interesting opportunity for you!

Your responsibilities:

• As a Maintenance Technician, you will support customers with their maintenance activities.
• You will mainly be responsible for preventive and corrective maintenance, repairs and the replacement of spare parts on industrial installations.
• You are able to work independently and are skilled in assembling and dismantling mechanical components.
• You will mainly work as part of the customer's technical maintenance team, always respecting the safety regulations applicable on site.
• You are responsible for accurately completing work orders and providing daily reports to the internal department.
• You work autonomously and maintain good communication with the customer.
• You have strong analytical skills to identify and troubleshoot technical faults and defects.
For this challenging position, you naturally need to have the right skills and experience.

• You have a strong ELECTRICAL & MECHANICAL BACKGROUND, with at least 5 years of experience as an industrial electrician.
• You are flexible regarding work locations, as you will work at different sites on a project basis.
• You are open to working in shifts (2-shift system, day shifts or night shifts – NEGOTIABLE).
• You are independent, eager to learn and not afraid of getting your hands dirty.
• You hold a valid category B driving licence and speak fluent DUTCH OR ENGLISH.

As a CE Driver, you'll manage regional trips starting from region Kortrijk.

You work independently: loading and unloading goods, checking transport documents, and staying in direct contact with planning and customers. 

Your days start early and you complete several trips a day. 

Looking for variety? Then this could be your next job. Apply quickly to find out if this is the right fit for you!

• Valid CE driver's license and Code 95

• Safety is your top priority

• You work independently and take responsibility

• Ready for physical work

• You speak fluent Dutch, French, or English

Do you have experience in production or a technical background, and are you willing to work in shifts? Do you speak Dutch or English fluently?

• As a Production Worker, you will be responsible for making safety boots.

• Assembling components (steel toe cap, lining and steel sole) onto the mould

• Cleaning the machine

• After completing internal training, you will also be able to operate two other machines

• Experience as a production worker is required

• You are eager to learn and have a strong focus on quality

• You have your own means of transport

• You have a good command of Dutch or English

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.
 

We are looking for experienced pharmaceutical professionals who want to actively contribute to the future of medicine. This is more than just a job, it is an opportunity to further develop your expertise and grow your career in a dynamic, mission-driven environment focused on patient impact.
 

If you already have experience in cleanroom operations, pharmaceutical manufacturing or chemical processes, or if you combine a relevant educational background with hands-on experience, we would very much like to hear from you.
 

Your role and responsibilities;
 
 
 
• Actively participate in aseptic and manual pharmaceutical manufacturing processes. 
 
• Work in cleanroom and laboratory environments in accordance with GMP standards. 
 
• Perform production activities in controlled environments (Grade A/B/C/D), including spiking, media exchanges, cell culture activities and freezing of therapeutic products. 
 
• Execute thorough cleaning and disinfection of materials and equipment. 
 
• Support transitions between production zones, ensuring compliance and continuity. 
 
 

This role is suited for you if you:
 

 
• Have relevant pharmaceutical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences.
 
• Have experience in a cleanroom, pharmaceutical, or chemical environment.
 
• Enjoy working in a structured environment and following procedures.
 
• Communicate fluently in English.
 
• Live near Zwijnaarde and can commute independently to the site.

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.
 

Start your career in Pharma in a Lab Support role!
 

Are you ready to make a real impact in the world of biotechnology? 
 

 
 

Are you detail-oriented and comfortable working in a rapid changing, clean environment with very strict procedures? Do you want to contribute to the production of innovative, life-saving cell therapies? Then this could be the opportunity for you.
 

After extensive training in aseptic working and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), you’ll join our Operations Team and support the production of the Carvykti treatment in a highly controlled cleanroom environment.
 

What You’ll Do
 

 
• Support the daily aseptic and manual production process, following strict procedures and quality standards.
 
• Prepare workstations, equipment, tools and materials for production.
 
• Clean and disinfect materials and equipment to maintain a sterile environment.
 
• Inspect equipment and ensure the correct transfer of materials between production zones.
 
• Work closely with operators and team leads to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality therapies to patients. 
 

Good to Know You’ll work in a sterile environment wearing protective clothing. This role follows a shift schedule including weekends. Full training is provided.

We are looking for you if:
 

 
• You live near Gent/Zwijnaarde or have reliable transportation such as bike or Car.
 
• Fluent in English, you thrive in teamwork and are eager to learn new skills.
 
• You are accountable and motivated to make a difference in patient's lives. 
 
• Your attention to detail is unmatched.
 
• Bonus points for familiarity with GMP standards, aseptic techniques, sterilization methods, and MS Office.

Our client, Legend Biotech, based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology company bringing the innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this, the Legend Biotech team makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

jobs.description:
Onze klant is op zoek naar een klantendienstmedewerker voor een pechdienst voor vrachtwagens in panne, over heel Europa. 

Our client is looking for a customer service representative for a roadside assistance service for broken-down trucks, operating throughout Europe.

 

Je komt terecht in een klein team, waar je wordt ondersteund door een teamleider en behulpzame collega’s. 

You will join a small team, where you will be supported by a team leader and helpful colleagues.

 

Afhandelen van telefoongesprekken en e-mails: reageren op vragen van klanten en betrokken partijen.

Handling telephone calls and emails: responding to inquiries from customers and involved parties.

 

Bieden van technische ondersteuning en communiceren met werkplaatsen ter plaatse. 

Providing technical support and communicating with on-site workshops.

 

Op de hoogte houden van de klant en alle andere betrokken partijen.

Keeping the client and all other involved parties informed

• Talen: Engels (zeer goed), Duits (goed) & Nederlands (goed)   // Language: English (very well), German (well) & Dutch (well)
• Computervaardigheden: Microsoft Office-toepassingen (Word, Excel, Outlook, …)  // Computer skills: Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, Outlook, …)
• Technische kennis (automobielsector, banden, …) is een pluspunt  // Technical knowledge (automotive, tyres, …) is a plus
• Werken van maandag tot en met vrijdag (met flexibiliteit om tijdens drukke periodes ook op zaterdag te werken) // Working from Monday through Friday (with the flexibility to also work on Saturdays during busy periods).
• Werken in wisselende diensten tussen 07:00 en 22:00 uur // Working in rotating shifts between 07:00 and 22:00.

jobs.occupation: Electric Pallet Truck (EPT) Orderpicker / Warehouse Operator - 2 Shifts | Evergem (Ghent region, ...
jobs.description:
As an essential link in our order fulfillment chain, your focus is safety, speed, and accuracy. Every day brings variety:
    
•   
Safely navigate the warehouse floor operating an Electric Pallet Truck (EPT) to pick, stage, and transfer orders.
    
•   
Execute precise loading and unloading procedures, ensuring all materials remain 100% damage-free.
    
•   
Follow structured warehouse safety protocols to stage, stack, and place incoming goods accurately.
    
•   
Support stock counting, inventory tracking, and swift shelf replenishment so goods are always ready to roll.
   

 
    
•   
Proven hands-on experience operating an Electric Pallet Truck (EPT), backed by a valid EPT certificate or license.
    
•   
Full availability and willingness to work in an alternating two-shift schedule (early and late shifts).
    
•   
Strong English communication skills to ensure seamless coordination and safety across the warehouse floor.
    
•   
Reliable personal transport (car, motorbike, or e-bike) to commute independently to the facility in Evergem.

Account Management & Business Development

• Develops and executes account plans to achieve sales, margin and customer development objectives.
• Builds strong relationships with key decision makers and acts as the primary commercial interface.
• Drives new business, range expansion, product introductions and cross-selling across relevant aftermarket channels.
• Maintains a strong opportunity pipeline and reliable sales forecasts.
Commercial & Performance Management

• Leads commercial negotiations, including pricing, annual agreements, rebates and promotional conditions.
• Monitors sales, profitability and key commercial KPIs, implementing corrective actions where required.
• Works with Finance on receivables, credit exposure and customer financial risk.
• Provides management with clear visibility on performance, opportunities, risks and required decisions.
Market, Portfolio & Customer Activation

• Maintains strong knowledge of the Benelux automotive aftermarket, customers, competition and market trends.
• Provides market insights to support pricing, portfolio and go-to-market decisions.
• Promotes company brands and products and coordinates launches, promotions and customer activation initiatives.
Operational Excellence, Collaboration & Compliance

• Coordinates with Supply Chain, Customer Service, Marketing, Product Management and Finance to ensure effective execution and resolve customer issues.
• Provides accurate demand forecasts and supports key operational requirements.
• Ensures compliance with company policies, approval processes and competition-law principles.
• Operates with autonomy, ownership and accountability across functions and geographies.

• Knowledge of the Microsoft Office environment
• Good negotiation skills
• Good sales argumentation about the company's portfolio
• Solid skills in Dutch, French & English, understanding written correspondence & understanding technical information
• Knowledge of CRM and business intelligence tools is considered an advantage
• Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional and international environment
• Good knowledge of forecasting, customer agreements and commercial performance management
• Strong key account management, negotiation and commercial planning capabilities
• Good understanding of the automotive aftermarket, its distribution channels and key commercial dynamics
